notes: 55" IPS UHD (3840x2160) commercial/digital-signage display, webOS 4.0, VESA 300x300 wall/arm mount only (not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted). Source is LG's own US product page (solutions.lg.com/us/digital-signage/lg-55ul3g-b), cross-checked against the equivalent LG UK page and a dealer spec sheet (commercialdisplayworks.com), all consistent. Caveats: (1) HDMI version not stated by LG — only HDCP 2.2/1.4 support is listed, so no HDMI grade was set (could be HDMI 1.4 or 2.0-class silicon; unconfirmed). (2) RJ45/LAN speed not stated, so no Ethernet grade was set. (3) RS232C In/Out are physically 4-pin phone-jacks per LG/dealer text, not DE-9 connectors — mapped to the generic "rs232" id since no closer id exists in the allowed list. (4) Audio-out jack shape and AC power inlet shape are not explicitly stated on LG's spec table; both were inferred from typical LG signage-display design (3.5mm audio out, IEC power inlet) and should be treated as unconfirmed. (5) An IR-in port is listed on LG's page under "Interface" but omitted from some of LG's own summarized spec tables — confirmed present via a direct page re-check.
